description: Defines data models for recipes, ingredients, instructions, and difficulty levels in a recipe application.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Data class representing a recipe with properties such as id, title, description, image URL, cuisine, prep and cook times, difficulty, servings, ingredients, instructions, and favorite status. Includes a computed property totalTime.

classes.name: Ingredient
classes.description: Data class representing an ingredient with name, amount, and unit. Includes a method to display the ingredient as a formatted string.

classes.name: InstructionStep
classes.description: Data class representing a step in the recipe instructions, with step number and instruction text.

classes.name: Difficulty
classes.description: Enum class defining difficulty levels for recipes: EASY, MEDIUM, HARD, with a custom string representation.

methods.name: toDisplayString
methods.description: Formats an Ingredient instance into a display string combining amount, unit, and name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method for the Difficulty enum to return a user-friendly string.
